Chapter 7115: Dragon Servants

Chapter 7115: Dragon Servants

Li Qiye rode the chariot up the world tree to the divine realm. By this point, even immortals showed up to greet him due to the order’s significance.

They prostrated once he exited the chariot: “Greetings, Order Lord. Thank you for bringing the order back.”

Their combined auras could lift worlds, spreading across the twenty-four firmaments. The chongming birds also appeared, both the young and old.

However, they weren’t at the grand-completion level. Only a few dozen could be seen despite having existed for epochs. This was a testament to their reproduction difficulty.

Despite their power, they still prostrated to show respect to the order. Alas, they were confused by Li Qiye’s lack of cultivation.

The little one in Li Qiye’s sleeve flew out and landed among its kins, screeching in happiness. The older ones heaved a sigh of relief since its disappearance had been stressing them. After all, a newborn was priceless for divine beasts.

Today, the elusive leader of the dragon servants also appeared - a cultivator known as Stone Immortal.

He had served both the previous divine beast and the current Chongming Bird. He had lived for a long time yet still possessed substantial life force.

“Buzz.” Halos appeared in the divine realm, bathing all inhabitants and restoring their vitality and youth.

“Greetings, Order Lord.” He knelt, looking far larger than Li Qiye due to his immense body.

The others confirmed that the order was the real thing.

“Order Lord, I apologize for my impudence but how did you come across the order?” He couldn’t help but ask due to the current circumstances.

“Your immortal lord’s personal guard, a vermillion bird, gave it to me.” Li Qiye answered.

“Vermillion...” He shuddered upon hearing this and exchanged glances with the adult chongming birds.

This loyal guard would always be there to protect his master unless there was a different order.

“Where is he right now?” Stone Immortal asked.

“Still alive, recovering.” Li Qiye answered.

They could imagine what had happened - a fierce battle ending with their lord being sealed.

“Do you know the lord’s whereabouts?” He inquired again.

All eyes were on Li Qiye since this was the most pivotal matter. They only knew the lord was sealed, nothing more.

“That I do not know, I am here to take something from the palace, that’s all.” Li Qiye smiled.
